heading.en: AN ARMY OF ELEPHANTS. | *STOPPED BY BIRDS.*

say.en: An army came with an elephant, sure of its strength. And Allah answered it with small birds. The Quran gave this story a whole surah.
say.hi: Ek lashkar haathi ke saath aaya, apni taaqat par yaqeen kiye hue. Aur Allah ne chhote parindon se jawab diya. Quran ne is waqiye ko poori ek surah di.

say.en: Surah Al-Fil begins with a question: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
say.hi: Surah Al-Fil ek sawal se shuru hoti hai: kya aapne nahi dekha ke aapke Rab ne haathi waalon ke saath kya kiya?

say.en: They came with a plan. And Allah made their plan go astray.
say.hi: Woh ek chaal le kar aaye the. Aur Allah ne unki chaal ko bekaar kar diya.

say.en: And He sent against them birds, in flocks.
say.hi: Aur Usne unpar parindon ke jhund ke jhund bheje.

say.en: Striking them with stones of hard, baked clay.
say.hi: Jo unpar pakki hui mitti ke patthar maar rahe the.

say.en: And He made them like straw that has been eaten. The mighty army, with its elephant, was gone.
say.hi: Aur Usne unhein khaaye hue bhoose ki tarah kar diya. Woh taaqatwar lashkar, apne haathi ke saath, khatam ho gaya.

card.quote_from: Verily Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, held back the Ele- phants from Mecca, and gave its domination to His Messenger and believers.

say.en: In the year Makkah was conquered, the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: Allah held back the elephants from Makkah.
say.hi: Fatah Makkah ke saal Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya: Allah ne haathiyon ko Makkah se rok diya.

heading.en: STOPPED BY HIM | *WHO STOPPED THE ELEPHANT*

say.en: At Hudaibiya, the Prophet's camel sat down and would not rise. People said she had become stubborn. He said: She was stopped by Him who stopped the elephant.
say.hi: Hudaibiya mein Nabi ki oontni baith gayi aur na uthi. Logon ne kaha woh ziddi ho gayi. Aap ne farmaya: use usi ne roka hai jisne haathi ko roka tha.

say.en: The very next surah tells Quraysh: Worship the Lord of this House, who fed them against hunger and made them safe from fear.
say.hi: Agli hi surah Quraish se kehti hai: is Ghar ke Rab ki ibadat karo, jisne unhein bhook mein khilaya aur khauf se aman diya.

heading.en: NO ARMY IS TOO BIG | *FOR ALLAH*
heading.hi: ALLAH KE AAGE | *KOI LASHKAR BADA NAHI*

say.en: Whatever stands against you today, however big it looks, Allah can stop it with the smallest of His creation. Trust Him, and worship Him.
say.hi: Aaj aapke saamne jo bhi khada hai, kitna bhi bada lage, Allah use apni sabse chhoti makhlooq se rok sakta hai. Usi par bharosa rakho, usi ki ibadat karo.

heading.en: SEND THIS TO SOMEONE | *WHO FEELS SMALL*
heading.hi: YEH USAY BHEJEIN | *JO KHUD KO KAMZOR SAMJHE*

say.en: Send this to someone who feels small against a big problem today.
say.hi: Yeh video usay bhejein jo aaj kisi badi mushkil ke saamne khud ko kamzor samajh raha hai.
